title: KOCHE ENZO 60 cm BLDC Chimney Autoclean Filterless | 1450 m³/hr Suction | Gesture + Touch Control | 9+1 Turbo Speed | Low Noise | 12 Yrs Motor & 2 Yrs Comprehensive Warranty | Energy Efficient
bullets: STRONG 1450 m³/hr SUCTION: Effectively removes smoke, oil fumes, grease, and steam. The curved glass design captures maximum smoke, making it perfect for Indian cooking styles like deep frying, grilling, tadka, and high-flame cooking.
ADVANCED BLDC MOTOR TECHNOLOGY: Advanced BLDC motor delivers powerful suction with 40% less noise, 2x longer motor life, and 40% lower electricity bills.

GESTURE CONTROL + TOUCH PANEL: Control your chimney even with messy hands while cooking using simple hand gestures. For added convenience, the responsive touch panel lets you adjust settings with ease.
INFOGRAPHIC DISPLAY SCREEN: Digital display shows speed, auto-clean mode, and other key functions at a glance.
HEAT AUTO CLEAN: Self-cleans after every 30 uses or at the touch of a button, helping keep the chimney performing at its best.
FILTER-LESS DESIGN: No baffle or mesh filters to scrub. The filter-less design ensures consistent suction with minimal maintenance.
